_note: SAMPLE DATA: Pre-event checklist template for milestone birthdays and private celebrations.
name: Milestone Birthday Party Checklist

items.title: Select Venue or Private Rooftop Space
items.description: Secure space reservation, confirm outside catering/alcohol policy and closing hours.

items.title: Theme Design & Color Palette Selection
items.description: Decide theme (Retro Neon, Golden Gala, Tropical Boho) and order personalized neon or marquee signage.

items.title: Custom Designer Cake Tasting & Order
items.description: Finalize flavor, tiered structure, sugar art design, and arrange refrigerated venue delivery time.

items.title: Book DJ / Acoustic Singer & Playlist Curation
items.description: Share birthday celebrant's must-play nostalgic anthems and 'do-not-play' list.

items.title: Send Digital Invites & Collect RSVPs
items.description: Circulate animated invite video or link, track headcount and dietary allergies.

items.title: Confirm Candid Photographer & 360 Spin Booth
items.description: Arrange equipment arrival 1 hour prior to guests for family portraits.

items.title: Final Bar & Grazing Table Quantities
items.description: Ensure adequate ice stock, signature cocktail mixers, and glassware counts.

items.title: Surprise Video Montage / Roast Screening Test
items.description: Test projector, HDMI cable, sound sync with AV technician.

items.title: Cake Table Setup, Sparkler Candles & Welcoming
items.description: Position cake table in prime lighting spot, distribute celebration sparklers.
